title: Fix component test failures from registry namespace conflicts
body:
CI failing with 12 tests in `@object-ui/components` - tests expecting UI components (img, input, textarea, etc.) getting null because `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid` overwrite registrations during test setup.

## Changes

**vitest.setup.tsx** - Extended existing re-registration pattern
- Added re-registrations for: email, password, textarea, image, html, avatar, select, slider, grid
- Follows existing pattern already in place for 'text' component
- Ensures tests get UI components ('ui' namespace) instead of field widgets ('field' namespace)

```tsx
// Pattern: Re-register after field/plugin imports to restore UI components
ComponentRegistry.register('email', 
  (props: any) => <InputRenderer {...props} schema={{ ...props.schema, inputType: 'email' }} />,
  { namespace: 'ui', label: 'Email Input' }
);
```

**apps/site/package.json** - Next.js 16.1.4 → 16.1.5
- Patches DoS vulnerability in React Server Components HTTP deserialization
- GHSA affecting 16.1.0-canary.0 through 16.1.4

## Context

ComponentRegistry lookup doesn't use namespace parameters, so last registration wins. Field widgets register after UI components during test initialization, causing tests to render field widgets instead of expected UI components.
